WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH) AS `orders___created_at`,
    SUM(orders.amount) AS `orders___amount_sum`
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH)
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    `orders___created_at`,
    `orders___amount_sum`,
    SUM(`orders___amount_sum`) OVER (ORDER BY `orders___created_at`) AS `orders___running`
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  `orders___created_at`,
  `orders___running`
FROM (
  SELECT
    `orders___created_at`,
    `orders___amount_sum`,
    `orders___running`
  FROM step1
  WHERE
    (
      `orders___running` > 250 OR `orders___running` < 50
    ) AND `orders___running` < 260
) AS _outer

where_having_or_mode_a::bigquery:
SELECT
  `orders___region`,
  `orders___amount_sum`
FROM (
  SELECT
    orders.region AS `orders___region`,
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___amount_sum`,
    COUNT(orders.amount) AS `orders___amount_count`,
    MAX(orders.amount) AS `orders___amount_max`
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.status = 'a' OR orders.status = 'b'
    )
    AND orders.amount > 15
    AND (
      orders.region = 'US' OR orders.region = 'EU'
    )
  GROUP BY
    orders.region
  HAVING
    (
      SUM(orders.amount) > 55 OR COUNT(orders.amount) > 2
    )
    AND MAX(orders.amount) < 1000
) AS _outer
